description: This source file implements a feature to list comments for an article specified by its slug. It contains a request class, a request handler that fetches the article with its comments and authors from the database, and throws a RestException if the article is not found.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Encapsulates the comment listing feature, including the query and its handler classes.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query to retrieve comments for an article identified by slug, or throws not found exception.
